test.result: 64 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for the custody module.

implemented: ManifestJournal can request an optional signed receipt through the TimestampProvider protocol.
UnconfiguredProvider does not fabricate a receipt and leaves the manifest LOCAL_ONLY.
Returned receipts are persisted in the durable manifest journal and reclassified against supplied trust roots on restart.
A receipt without a pinned trusted root remains UNVERIFIED and cannot count as independent verification.
blockers: No owner-approved external timestamp API or trust root is configured; fixture receipt is not independent evidence.
Provider credentials, endpoint reliability and independent receipt operations require owner-side configuration.
